justification: Both surfaces present one large stylised subject filling a bordered rectangular field, rendered in bold continuous outline with curvilinear scroll and hook fillers, which gives a loose stylistic kinship. But the depicted subjects differ fundamentally: A shows a standing frontal human figure with a towering ornate headdress and dense glyph-like elements, while B shows a single striding quadruped animal in profile with no human presence or sign band.
